description: Institutional-grade read-only trader intelligence dashboard for Polylens paper analytics.

options.content:
# Polylens Trader Intelligence
**Read-only · Paper-only · Institutional Analytics**

Operator dashboard for signal validation, gate control, recommendation flow, and paper portfolio monitoring. No live execution paths are connected.

panels.description: All persisted trader signals across families.

targets.rawSql: SELECT total_signals AS value FROM v_dashboard_overview
SELECT datetime(trend_date) AS time, SUM(signal_count) AS value FROM v_signal_performance_trend GROUP BY trend_date ORDER BY trend_date

panels.title: Total Signals

panels.description: Overall resolved validation accuracy across all signal families.

targets.rawSql: SELECT validation_accuracy AS value FROM v_dashboard_overview
SELECT datetime(validation_date) AS time, accuracy AS value FROM v_validation_trend ORDER BY validation_date

panels.title: Validation Accuracy

panels.description: Signal families meeting validation count and accuracy gate thresholds.

targets.rawSql: SELECT proven_families AS value FROM v_dashboard_overview

panels.title: Proven Signal Families

panels.description: Recommendations blocked by validation gates or eligibility rules.

targets.rawSql: SELECT blocked_recommendations AS value FROM v_dashboard_overview

panels.title: Blocked Recommendations

panels.description: Paper bridge intents in simulated status — analytics only, no order placement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT simulated_paper_intents AS value FROM v_dashboard_overview
SELECT datetime(trend_date) AS time, simulated_count AS value FROM v_intent_trend ORDER BY trend_date

panels.title: Simulated Paper Intents

panels.description: Historical accuracy by signal family: early_entry, conviction, exit, consensus, contrarian.

targets.rawSql: SELECT signal_type, accuracy FROM v_signal_family_performance ORDER BY accuracy DESC

panels.title: Signal Family Accuracy

panels.description: Average ROI proxy by family for institutional performance comparison.

targets.rawSql: SELECT signal_type, avg_roi_proxy AS roi_proxy FROM v_signal_family_performance ORDER BY avg_roi_proxy DESC

panels.title: Signal Family ROI Proxy

panels.description: Sample depth per family — gate promotion requires sufficient validation history.

targets.rawSql: SELECT signal_type, validation_count FROM v_signal_family_performance ORDER BY validation_count DESC

panels.title: Validation Count by Family

panels.description: Families cleared for paper bridge promotion.

targets.rawSql: SELECT proven_count AS value FROM v_gate_status_summary

panels.title: Proven Families

panels.description: Families with enough samples but below accuracy threshold.

targets.rawSql: SELECT weak_count AS value FROM v_gate_status_summary

panels.title: Weak Families

panels.description: Families lacking minimum validation depth.

targets.rawSql: SELECT unproven_count AS value FROM v_gate_status_summary

panels.title: Unproven Families

panels.description: Highest-confidence proven or developing family score (0-100).

targets.rawSql: SELECT confidence_score AS value FROM v_gate_confidence ORDER BY confidence_rank ASC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Top Gate Confidence

panels.description: Ranked gate confidence table for operator review and family prioritization.

targets.rawSql: SELECT confidence_rank, signal_type, gate_status, validation_count, accuracy, confidence_score, rolling_7_day_accuracy, rolling_30_day_accuracy FROM v_gate_confidence ORDER BY confidence_rank

panels.title: Gate Confidence Rankings

panels.description: End-to-end read-only flow from signal generation through paper intent simulation.
panels.title: Pipeline Flow

panels.description: Recommendations passing gate and eligibility checks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT promoted_count AS value FROM v_recommendation_pipeline

panels.title: Promoted Recommendations

panels.description: Recommendations halted by gate status or policy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT blocked_count AS value FROM v_recommendation_pipeline

panels.title: Blocked Recommendations

panels.description: Daily promoted vs blocked recommendation volume.

targets.rawSql: SELECT datetime(trend_date) AS time, promoted_count, blocked_count, recommendation_count FROM v_recommendation_trend ORDER BY trend_date

panels.title: Recommendation Trend

panels.description: Watch-list paper intents awaiting operator review.

targets.rawSql: SELECT candidate_count AS value FROM v_paper_intent_pipeline

panels.title: Candidate Intents

panels.description: Simulated paper-copy intents from proven paper_entry recommendations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT simulated_count AS value FROM v_paper_intent_pipeline

panels.title: Simulated Intents

panels.description: Intents blocked by gates, score thresholds, or eligibility.

targets.rawSql: SELECT blocked_count AS value FROM v_paper_intent_pipeline

panels.title: Blocked Intents

panels.description: Latest paper intents with notional sizing, signal source, and gate rationale.

targets.rawSql: SELECT trader_address AS signal_source, signal_type, status, notional_usd, gate_status, gate_reason, side, market_id, score, created_at FROM v_latest_paper_intents ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Paper Intent Book

targets.rawSql: SELECT trader_address, validation_count, accuracy, avg_roi_proxy, trader_tier FROM v_trader_leaderboard WHERE trader_tier = 'top' ORDER BY accuracy DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT trader_address, validation_count, accuracy, avg_roi_proxy, trader_tier FROM v_trader_leaderboard WHERE trader_tier = 'weak' ORDER BY accuracy ASC LIMIT 12
SELECT trader_address, validation_count, correct_count, accuracy, avg_roi_proxy, trader_tier FROM v_trader_leaderboard ORDER BY accuracy DESC, validation_count DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT trader_address, validation_count, correct_count, incorrect_count, accuracy, trader_tier FROM v_trader_leaderboard ORDER BY validation_count DESC, accuracy DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Daily validation accuracy and sample volume.

targets.rawSql: SELECT datetime(validation_date) AS time, accuracy, validation_count FROM v_validation_trend ORDER BY validation_date

panels.title: Validation Trend

panels.description: Daily signal generation volume across all families.

targets.rawSql: SELECT datetime(trend_date) AS time, SUM(signal_count) AS signal_count FROM v_signal_performance_trend GROUP BY trend_date ORDER BY trend_date

panels.title: Signal Trend

panels.description: Audit view of recommendation pipeline throughput.

targets.rawSql: SELECT datetime(trend_date) AS time, recommendation_count, promoted_count, blocked_count FROM v_recommendation_trend ORDER BY trend_date

panels.title: Recommendation Trend (Audit)

panels.description: Datastore freshness and row counts for operator health checks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT signal_rows, validation_rows, recommendation_rows, intent_rows, latest_signal_at, latest_validation_at, latest_recommendation_at, latest_intent_at, read_only, paper_only FROM v_database_health

panels.title: Database Health
